Anime wallpapers for every display, as a native Windows 11 app. This release makes browsing faster and lighter on memory, works offline for things you've already seen, and adds a full-screen preview.

## Download

**[MrWallpaper-Setup.msi](https://github.com/Subhranil-Maity/MrWallpaper/releases/download/v1.1.0/MrWallpaper-Setup.msi)** (Windows 10 1809+ / Windows 11, x64)

- Installs just for your user account in `%LocalAppData%\Programs\MrWallpaper`, so no administrator rights are needed.
- .NET and the Windows App SDK runtime are bundled, so there's nothing else to install.
- Upgrading from 1.0.0 replaces the old version in place. Your library, settings and downloaded wallpapers are kept.
- The installer isn't code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn you the first time. Choose **More info → Run anyway**.

## What's new

### Hold Space to preview
Hold **Space** over any tile in Explore or Library to see it over the whole window. The cached thumbnail appears instantly, then the full-quality image loads in (with progress). Let go of Space, press Esc or click to close it. You can turn this off in **Settings → Appearance**.

### Tiles pop out on hover
Explore and Library tiles grow slightly and lift while the pointer is over them. You can turn this off in **Settings → Appearance**, and it's skipped automatically when Windows animation effects are off.

### On-disk cache: faster, and works offline
- Thumbnails, full-size images, wallpaper details and recent searches are cached in `%LocalAppData%\MrWallpaper\Cache` and loaded from disk next time.
- Recent searches show up instantly while fresh results load. If Wallhaven can't be reached, you see the cached results and a "You're offline" notice.
- Saving a wallpaper you've already viewed at full size moves the cached file into your library instead of downloading it again.
- The Library grid uses small thumbnails instead of decoding full-size images, which cuts memory use a lot for big libraries.
- A new **Settings → Storage** section shows cache usage, sets size limits for previews and full images (oldest unused files are removed first), and has a **Clear cache** button.

### Search history
The Explore search box suggests your last 20 searches. Remove one with its ✕ button or **Shift+Delete**, or clear them all in Settings.

### Explore
- New **Top → All time** range. Wallhaven's toplist stops at one year, so this ranks by favorites with no cut-off.
- The time ranges are now called "Past day" … "Past year", because they're rolling windows rather than calendar periods.
- Explore always opens with the default filters (Top, past month, anime, SFW).

## Fixes
- Endless scrolling no longer stops after the first page when a page contains only wallpapers that were already shown.
- The title bar is now the same height as the minimize, maximize and close buttons, so its contents line up with them.
